text: Runs entirely offline as a self-hosted AI platform
quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline

text: Supports fully air-gapped deployments with complete network isolation
quote: Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.

text: Works with local Ollama models as well as OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs through one provider-agnostic interface
quote: With support for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, it gives you a powerful, provider-agnostic interface for both local and cloud-based models.

text: Chat with Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible provider from a single interface
quote: Chat with Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible provider from a single interface.

text: Switch models mid-conversation while keeping context intact
quote: Talk to any model, switch mid-conversation, and keep your context intact.

text: Run two models side-by-side and compare their responses
quote: Run two models side-by-side and compare responses

text: Connects to Open Responses providers out of the box
quote: Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal) and connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and Open Responses providers out of the box.

text: Lets you choose which service handles each job, such as transcription or image generation
quote: Open WebUI lets you choose which service does each job.

text: Personal API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses
quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.

text: Scripts authenticate with a single Authorization Bearer header
quote: your scripts can do with a single `Authorization: Bearer` header.

text: Built-in Swagger API docs at /docs on a self-hosted instance when ENV=dev
quote: Open WebUI documents a built-in FastAPI Swagger surface on a running self-hosted instance, gated behind dev mode: "Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation" at /docs. This is a se

text: Per-service Swagger documentation links for exploring the API on your own instance
quote: The same reference lists "Swagger Documentation Links" per service ("Access detailed API documentation for different services provided by Open WebUI", Main at /docs): the built-in interactive Swagger UI on the integrator's own instance, ava

text: Maintains a changelog with a Semantic Versioning commitment and per-version plugin migration guides
quote: Open WebUI keeps a Keep-a-Changelog repository changelog with a SemVer commitment ("this project adheres to Semantic Versioning") and publishes per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases. The REST API reference itself is

text: Functions are modular Python plugins that extend Open WebUI itself
quote: Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.

text: Anything you can write in Python can be turned into a Function
quote: If you can write it in Python, you can turn it into a Function.

text: Plugins can add new Python-powered models and intercept and transform every message in the system
quote: They can add entirely new "models" powered by any Python logic, intercept and transform every message flowing through the system

text: Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on the server
quote: Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.

text: Custom models or agents appear as selectable models in the chat sidebar
quote: Adds a custom model or agent | Appears as a selectable model in the chat sidebar

text: Share what you build and run what others share
quote: Connect to any model, local or cloud. Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.

text: Native MCP support for calling tools exposed by MCP servers, starting in v0.6.31
quote: You can now call tools exposed by your MCP server from Open WebUI.

text: Automations schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times through the normal chat pipeline
quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline

text: Automations can be paused and resumed without deleting them
quote: Pause/resume automations without deleting them

text: Web search lets the AI look up information online and cite sources in real time
quote: AI searches the web and cites sources in real time

text: Native function calling lets models autonomously explore the web, verify facts, and follow links
quote: By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.

text: Persistent memory lets models remember facts, preferences, and context across conversations
quote: Open WebUI includes a sophisticated memory system that allows models to remember facts, preferences, and context across different conversations.

text: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories in settings
quote: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory

text: Channels are persistent shared spaces where multiple users and models join one conversation
quote: Channels let multiple users and multiple models interact in a single timeline.

text: RAG retrieves context from local and remote documents, web content, and YouTube videos into chat answers
quote: retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.

text: Installable as a Progressive Web App on phone home screens, desktop taskbars, or the dock
quote: Open WebUI is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your phone's home screen, your desktop taskbar, or your dock.

text: Role-based access control with Admin, User, and Pending roles
quote: Open WebUI implements a flexible and secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system.

text: Admins manage user capabilities and resource access through three interconnected permission layers
quote: This system allows administrators to precisely manage user capabilities and access to resources through three interconnected layers

text: Install via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)
quote: Effortless Setup: Install seamlessly via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)

text: Install with a single pip install open-webui command
quote: pip install open-webui

text: Go from zero to a first AI conversation in under five minutes
quote: From zero to your first AI conversation in under five minutes.

text: Organize conversations however you work
quote: Organize conversations however you work

text: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls
quote: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls

text: Cloud-based transcription option that needs no local GPU
quote: This provides cloud-based transcription without needing local GPU resources.

text: Run Python code directly in the browser or via Open Terminal
quote: Run Python directly in the browser or via Open Terminal

text: The AI can install dependencies, write an app, start its server, and inspect the output
quote: Your AI can install dependencies, write the app, start its server, and inspect the output.

text: Optional workspace sandbox controls where the AI can work with your files, tools, and local models
quote: It brings your files, tools, and local models into chat, with an optional workspace sandbox to choose where the AI can work.

text: Open WebUI Computer serves your machine's files, terminal, editor, git, and sessions to any browser
quote: Open WebUI Computer (`cptr`) runs on your machine and serves your whole computer to any browser: files, terminal, editor, git, browser tabs, running sessions, AI agents, and tools.

text: Pick coding agents like Claude Code or Codex from the model picker like any other model
quote: Pick Claude Code, Codex or another listed agent from the model picker like any other model.

text: Sub-agents let a model hand off focused work to a second agent running in parallel
quote: Sub-agents let a model hand a focused piece of work to a second agent that runs in parallel, then use the result to continue.

text: Image generation and editing via OpenAI APIs or OpenAI-compatible image servers like Azure OpenAI or LiteLLM
quote: Open WebUI supports image generation and editing through the **OpenAI APIs**, and through any server with an OpenAI compatible images API such as Azure OpenAI or LiteLLM.

text: Selector for DALL·E 2, DALL·E 3, and GPT-Image models with different image sizes
quote: This option includes a selector for choosing between DALL·E 2, DALL·E 3, and the GPT-Image models, each supporting different image sizes.

text: Personal webhook notifies users when a chat response is ready, useful for long-running tasks
quote: A personal webhook that notifies individual users when a response to their chat is ready, especially useful for long-running tasks.

text: Webhooks send automated notifications to Discord, Slack, and other apps that accept incoming webhooks
quote: These webhooks allow you to receive automated notifications in external services like Discord, Slack or any other application that supports incoming webhooks

text: External services can post messages into Open WebUI channels
quote: receive automated notifications in external services like Discord, Slack ... as well as post messages from external services into Open WebUI channels.
